sec.clues.sub: Read what hides under a block
sec.people.sub: Stand-ins: they dig, build and fight
sec.parts.sub: Borrowed arms, legs and a tail
lesson.start.title: Pick your start
lesson.start.text: The city is under quarantine. Tap any block: your Command Center lands there and the first two heroes step out. Nothing dangerous spawns right next to it.
lesson.start.tip: Starting near the middle leaves more room to build.
lesson.dig.title: Clear blocks
lesson.dig.text: Swipe across closed blocks. Free heroes walk over and clear them, and the ring shows the work left. Together they dig faster. Every block gives 5 Energy.
lesson.dig.tip: Tap a queued block to remove it.
lesson.clue.title: A number counts neighbors
lesson.clue.text: A number on an open block tells how many things hide in the 8 blocks around it. A red number means nests and hero lairs. Tap the number and the game lights up its neighbors.
lesson.clue.tip: A block with no number means nothing is nearby: all its neighbors are safe to dig.
lesson.deduce.title: Work it out
lesson.deduce.text: This 1 has only one closed neighbor, so the nest is there. The next 1 has now found its nest, so its other neighbors are safe. The scanner puts a green check on them.
lesson.deduce.tip: A check means dig away. A red mark means danger.
lesson.build.title: Build your base
lesson.build.text: Tap an open tile of your land and the build menu appears. Pick a building: a hero walks over and builds it. Every building frees the land around it, and that's how your base grows.
lesson.build.tip: Microreactor first, it makes Energy by itself. Then a Hero Dorm: +1 hero slot and level 2 heroes.
lesson.fight.title: Heroes fight on their own
lesson.fight.text: Every hero digs and fights. When an enemy comes close, nearby heroes drop their work, gather and strike together, then go back to digging. Tap an enemy to send everyone there.
lesson.fight.tip: A hero at a quarter health falls back to a building to heal. The Command Center hits nearby enemies too.
lesson.parts.title: Trophies make you stronger
lesson.parts.text: The hero who lands the final blow takes the enemy's arm or leg and fits it right away. An ice adaptant gives an ice arm, a fire one a fire arm. An infected hero drops two parts at once.
lesson.parts.tip: Fight infected heroes from weak to strong: the weak ones give parts that make the strong ones easier.
clue.threat.name: Red number ▲
clue.threat.text: How many adaptant nests and hero lairs are among the 8 neighboring blocks. Open one and enemies come out.
clue.finds.name: Cyan number ◆
clue.finds.text: How many useful finds are nearby: HeroOut caches and Control warehouses full of citizens. These blocks are worth digging.
clue.many.name: Several numbers
clue.many.text: If both nests and finds are near, a block shows small numbers in the corners: cyan left, red right, purple bottom.
clue.empty.name: Empty block
clue.empty.text: No number means nothing nearby: all neighbors are safe and the scanner checks them. Which to dig is up to you.
clue.safe.name: Green check
clue.safe.text: The scanner proved from the numbers there's no nest or lair here. Dig away.
clue.danger.name: Red hotspot mark
clue.danger.text: The scanner proved there's a nest or a hero lair here. Swipes skip this block. To open it, tap the mark and confirm.
clue.caution.name: Your caution flag
clue.caution.text: Hold your finger on a closed block to flag it as suspicious. Swipes leave it alone.
clue.scanner.name: HeroOut scanner
clue.scanner.text: A drone that marks only what follows for certain from the numbers. It never guesses. On Normal it runs on the Scan button: 3 charges, one more every 60 seconds.
clue.accident.name: Opened a nest by accident
clue.accident.text: Opening a nest is not a loss. A fight starts, and the game highlights the number that warned you about it.
res.energy.text: The only resource. Comes from every cleared block, caches, energy veins, rubble, nests and infected heroes. Microreactors make it by themselves. Spent on buildings and on printing level 2–4 heroes.
res.energy.how: Energy flies to the Command Center as an orb and counts when it lands.
res.residents.text: Buildings send heroes out. You start with two; you have 2 slots plus one per Hero Dorm. Every hero digs, builds and fights.
res.threat.name: Threat
res.threat.text: The red ring in the corner. Every 2 minutes threat rises: enemies get tougher, nests spawn faster, their parts get stronger. Unopened heroes eventually come out by themselves.
people.resident.how: An enemy within 3 blocks of a hero or building: nearby heroes drop their work, gather a couple of blocks from it and strike together. They go back 3 seconds after the fight. Tap an enemy to send everyone there.
people.ranks.name: Ranks
people.ranks.text: A hero's rank depends on trophies: Shift Rookie (0), Veteran (1–2), Champion (3–4). A hero never carries more than four trophies.
parts.how.name: How trophies work
parts.how.text: Many enemies wear a borrowed body part. The hero who lands the final blow takes it and fits it in place of their own limb. If the slot is taken, it replaces a weaker part. A spare part is recycled into Energy.
parts.slots.name: Slots
parts.slots.text: Six slots: two arms, two legs, a tail and wings. A trophy replaces the hero's own limb, but no hero carries more than four trophies.
parts.tech.text: The trophy matches the enemy's element, and every part protects its owner from that element.
part.thermo_arm.text: Hits set the target burning for 3 more seconds.
part.volt_arm.text: The charge jumps to a nearby enemy.
part.runner_leg.text: Run faster, more health. From ordinary adaptants.
part.piston_leg.text: Lots of health and armor. From heavy adaptants.
part.drill_tail.text: A powerful area hit. Only from the Demon.
enemy.adaptant.how: They leave the nest and head for the nearest building or hero. Almost half carry a part you can take.
enemy.adaptant.techs: Elements: fire (orange), ice (blue), lightning (yellow), toxin (green). Each is weak to its predator on the element cycle.
enemy.heavy.how: One per nest; a new one comes out 30 seconds after the last falls. Always drops a trophy, one tier higher.
enemy.nest.how: Releases 3 adaptants at once, then one every 4 seconds while fewer than 8 are alive. Destroy the nest to stop the flow: +40 Energy.
enemy.demon.how: Raises its drill tail before a steam blast. The jet reaches 3 tiles ahead and leaves hot ground. You win when the Demon is down and the ground has cooled.
enemy.hatch.how: Open it when the squad is ready. Wait too long and the Demon comes out by itself at minute 15, with a one-minute warning.
map.rubble.how: Mark it with a swipe: heroes clear it in 24 seconds and get 30 Energy.
map.vein.how: Mark it with a swipe: two heroes mine 1 Energy every 2 seconds, 120 in total.
map.water.how: Can't walk or build here. Plan a path around.
map.cache.how: +20 Energy and a pick of one of three boosts until the end of the shift.
map.survivor.how: Opening it lets 3–5 citizens out, and they run to the Command Center on their own. They don't fight, and nearby enemies hunt them: cover them with heroes. Each one who makes it gives +10 Energy and shift points.
ctrl.tap.name: Tap
ctrl.tap.text: Your first tap places the Command Center. Tap a number to light up its neighbors. Tap a queued block to remove it.
ctrl.swipe.name: Swipe
ctrl.swipe.text: Drag a finger or the mouse across blocks to queue them for clearing. Known hotspots and your flags are skipped.
ctrl.hold.name: Hold
ctrl.hold.text: On a closed block, sets or removes a caution flag. On a building or a creature, shows a tooltip.
ctrl.order.name: Tap an enemy
ctrl.order.text: Heroes fight on their own. Tap an enemy, a nest or a lair and all heroes nearby go there. Tap empty ground to cancel.
ctrl.build.name: Build and print
ctrl.build.text: There's no separate button. Tap an open tile of your land to build. Tap your building to send a hero out.
ctrl.keys.name: Keyboard
ctrl.keys.text: Space pauses, Esc cancels a selection, right click removes a block from the queue.
ctrl.pause.name: Pause
ctrl.pause.text: While paused you can plan digs and buildings; they start when you resume. Online games have no pause.
world.city.name: Lumen City
world.city.text: A sunny coastal city of the future: white towers, rooftop gardens, a monorail. After the catastrophe its blocks were sealed under quarantine.
world.heroout.name: HeroOut
world.heroout.text: An emergency-care corporation. It supplies the city with rescuers, prosthetics and swappable body parts. To HeroOut a body is just a carrier.
world.splice.name: Splice Medium
world.splice.text: A medical carrier that negotiates with foreign tissue. It's why an arm, a leg or a tail can be transplanted here. No magic.
world.catastrophe.name: The catastrophe
world.catastrophe.text: At a demo of the EVERYONE IS ON CALL protocol, Splice Medium got into a reactor. The rescue network became a network of runaway adaptation.
world.adaptants.name: Adaptants
world.adaptants.text: Citizens Splice Medium rebuilt for someone else's task. Not evil, they just can't stop.
world.control.name: Control
world.control.text: HeroOut's voice on air. Politely reminds you that all citizens and all heroes are company assets.
world.you.name: You
world.you.text: The shift coordinator. Your job: open the city, send heroes out and stop the infected hero the call is about.
coach.clue.name: NUMBERS
coach.build.name: BUILDING
coach.fight.name: COMBAT
coach.parts.name: TROPHIES
coach.threat.name: THREAT
coach.threat.title: Threat went up
coach.threat.text: Every 2 minutes enemies get tougher and their trophies stronger. Don't stall: collect parts and go for the call target.
coach.finds.name: FINDS
coach.finds.title: Cyan number
coach.finds.text: A HeroOut cache or a Control warehouse with citizens is nearby. Clear this number's neighbors.
cap.command_up: Center up, two heroes step out
cap.one_closed: Only one is closed: the nest is there
cap.overlap: This number's nest is already found
cap.place: A hero walks over to build
cap.built: The building frees land around it
cap.tap_enemy: Tap an enemy: heroes go there
cap.nest_open: Nest open: the fight is on
cap.finds: Cyan number: a find is nearby
lesson.elements.title: The element cycle
lesson.elements.text: Every hero and every arm has an element. Lightning beats Ice, Ice beats Fire, Fire beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Lightning. A hero picks the arm that hurts the target most.
lesson.elements.tip: An enemy barely feels its own element, while its predator on the cycle hits one and a half times harder.
lesson.call.title: Emergency call
lesson.call.text: Every shift is a call on one infected hero. Purple numbers lead to its lair. Defeat it and the shift is closed. Red numbers also hide other infected heroes' lairs: optional, but they drop strong parts.
lesson.call.tip: Don't stall: enemies grow tougher every 2 minutes, infected heroes come out on their own, and the call target at minute 15.
clue.boss.name: Purple number ⬢
clue.boss.text: The lair of the hero you were called on is among the 8 neighbors. There's only one on the map.
bld.command.text: The heart of the base: 250 health, hits nearby enemies and heals heroes. Prints level 1 heroes for free. If it falls, the shift is lost.
bld.home.text: Prints heroes up to level 2, gives +1 hero slot and shelter for three heroes.
bld.reactor.text: Makes 1 Energy every 3 seconds by itself. No worker needed.
bld.cooler.text: Neighboring microreactors work twice as fast. Two stations don't stack.
bld.school.text: Prints heroes up to level 3, three Schools up to 4. Each School (up to three) trains every hero: +10 health, +2 damage, +0.5 armor.
bld.medcenter.text: Heals heroes within two tiles and regrows a torn limb in a minute.
parts.heroes.name: Hero parts
parts.heroes.text: An infected hero drops two parts: the arm to whoever finished it, the leg, wings or tail to whoever dealt the most damage after them. Hero parts carry the hero's ability.
part.toxin_arm.text: Hits poison the target and lower its armor.
elem.cycle.name: The element cycle
elem.choose.name: Heroes choose
elem.choose.text: Before every hit a hero picks the arm that hurts this target most. So your heroes' elements and trophies decide a fight with an infected hero.
elem.resist.name: Element protection
elem.resist.text: Each part of an element cuts damage of that element to its owner by 12% per tier. A hero with a fire arm barely minds steam.
elem.mult.name: Multipliers
elem.mult.text: Strong weakness ×1.5, weakness ×1.25, normal ×1, resistance ×0.75, strong resistance ×0.5. Bare hands hit everyone the same.
elem.reactions.name: Reactions
elem.reactions.text: Two elements in a row on one target trigger a strong effect. That's why heroes of different elements pay off.
hero.call.name: Emergency call
hero.lairs.name: Hero lairs
hero.lairs.text: Each map has three lairs of infected heroes: a weak, a medium and a strong one. Leave them closed and they come out on their own, the stronger the later. Optional, but their parts help a lot in the main fight.
hero.allies.name: Backup archive
hero.allies.text: From the first shift you have four backups: Standard, Patch, Gardener, Current. The rest are restored when you meet a hero's condition, usually beating its infected version. An unlocked hero can go on shift in every match.
ability.standard: Comes as three copies, each with a third of the health.
ability.patch: Very fast: steals flying Energy orbs and runs off.
ability.canopy: Every 10 seconds grows thickets that bog heroes down.
ability.current: A 3-tile jet pushes heroes back and washes off their buffs.
ability.lineman: Every 7 seconds pulls a hero in with a cable and stuns them.
ability.frostline: Every 6 seconds a cone kick: damage and chill.
ability.mason: Props up supports across streets and blocks heroes' paths.
ability.sweep: Every 8 seconds a steam cloud burns heroes around.
ability.beacon: A signal flare makes nearby nests spawn twice as fast.
ability.hive: A drone swarm stings up to four heroes and poisons them.
ability.kiln: Every 8 seconds a 3-tile charge: heavy damage and knockback.
ability.seraph: Heals other enemies nearby and flies over water. Hit her first.
ability.doctor: Every 10 seconds injects gel into the nearest enemy: tougher and healing.
ability.demon: Raises its tail and blasts steam 3 tiles ahead, leaving hot ground.
ability.n73: Takes over a hero for 6 seconds: they fight their own.
enemy.lair.how: Open it when your heroes are ready. Otherwise the infected hero comes out alone: weak ones early, strong ones later.
enemy.boss.how: The call target: Kiln, Seraph, the Doctor or the Demon. Comes out at minute 15 with a one-minute warning. Defeat it and the shift is closed.
world.heroes.name: Infected heroes
world.heroes.text: Fifteen HeroOut rescuers got infected with gel and keep "rescuing" people by protocol. Their stand-ins from old backups now work for you.
coach.hero.name: HERO
coach.hero.title: An infected hero is out
coach.hero.text: An infected hero is heading for the city. Gather your heroes and tap it. Winning drops two strong parts and brings its backup closer.
coach.call.name: CALL
coach.elements.name: ELEMENTS
cap.drop_tools: Enemy close: heroes drop their work
cap.hero_out: An infected hero leaves its lair
cap.picks: Mix elements: someone has the right one
coach.call.title: The call target is waking
coach.call.text: In a minute the infected hero you were called on comes out by itself. Gather heroes with the best arms and meet it. Winning closes the shift.
coach.elements.title: Elements
coach.elements.text: Heroes and arms have elements. Lightning beats Ice, Ice beats Fire, Fire beats Toxin, Toxin beats Impact, Impact beats Lightning. Heroes pick what to hit with.
lesson.birth.title: Send heroes out
lesson.birth.text: Tap a building and choose who goes on shift. The center prints level 1 heroes for free, the Dorm up to level 2, the School up to level 3. "Auto" picks the hero whose element works best against the nearest enemy.
lesson.birth.tip: You have 2 hero slots plus one per Hero Dorm. Beating infected heroes unlocks new ones.
people.ours.name: Who our heroes are
people.ours.text: Stand-ins: copies of HeroOut heroes printed from backups taken before the gel outbreak. So they're sane, but weaker than the infected originals: 60% health, 80% damage, 60% armor.
people.birth.name: Printing heroes
people.birth.text: Tap a building and pick a hero. A building prints one hero at a time. The Command Center prints level 1, a Hero Dorm up to 2, a School up to 3, three Schools up to 4.
people.birth.auto: "Auto" prints the hero whose element is strongest against the nearest known enemy.
people.cap.name: Hero slots
people.cap.text: Two slots from the Command Center plus one per Hero Dorm. With no free slot, printing won't start.
people.knockout.name: Knockout and stump
people.knockout.text: A hero with no health drops out and comes back at their building in 30–60 seconds. The enemy tears off one limb: no arm means −20% damage, no leg −25% speed. Take a part for that slot from an enemy, or the Med Center regrows it in a minute.
people.rally.name: Stronger together
people.rally.text: Heroes don't charge in one by one: they gather first, then strike together. Three heroes clear a block more than twice as fast, and damage on one target adds up.
map.boons.name: Cache boosts
map.boons.text: A HeroOut cache lets you pick one boost out of three. It lasts until the end of the shift.
coach.birth.name: HEROES
coach.birth.title: Send a hero out
coach.birth.text: Tap a building and choose who to print. "Auto" picks an element against the nearest enemy.
coach.knockout.name: KNOCKOUT
coach.knockout.title: A hero is down
coach.knockout.text: They come back at their building, minus one limb. Take a part for that slot from an enemy, or the Med Center regrows it.
cap.limb: The enemy tore off an arm
cap.regrow: The Med Center regrows the arm
